Pilbara lithium shipments rise

Western Australian lithium producers reported higher concentrate shipments this month as spodumene prices stabilised across the region, according to port data.

Operators in the Pilbara said logistics performance improved after the rail maintenance window completed ahead of schedule, allowing stockpiles to rebuild at the export terminals.

Analysts expect steady volumes into the next quarter, though they caution that downstream conversion margins remain compressed and restocking by cathode makers has been gradual.
